title: Disable security services and filtering drivers
description: Aggressive desktop profile: disable Defender, security health reporting, web threat protection, BitLocker service, application identity, smart-card propagation, and related diagnostic hosts. The Windows Firewall policy is disabled separately by registry.windows-firewall, while mpsdrv, BFE, and MpsSvc remain available so Windows Shell AppX packages can register their windows.firewall extension and keep the Windows 11 Explorer/input experience intact. Keep CryptSvc, RPC, DHCP, DNS, Workstation, audio, input, user profiles, and licensing services for office, entertainment, networking, and desktop startup.
